An FPS horror experience with Roguelike elements sprinkled in.

The Demo Version will offer a simplistic stripped down version of the full game, featuring but not limited to:


3 floors [random/procedurally made]
pickups/consumables
First level skills available
4 playable classes

Full game should be ready within the week, and will be featuring 


FPS mechanics (Guns/enemy entities)
More floors
Perma-death mechanics
+more

notes.title: The Dead Rooms DEMO Is LIVE!

DEMO v 30
Try the Demo for free!, this will  contain the base immersive mechanics of the game to give you a taste of whats coming..full version will include more rooms, weapons, FPS mechanics, Rouge Like Mechanics,  replay ability, more skills ect. if you like what you see WISHLIST to be alerted when the full release is available.
